topic: Two lasting changes an unlocked terminal can still make
detail: From the D-78 security review (low): (1) a spaces draft saved from an unlocked terminal is recorded as the operator's own (ByOperator), so when Orch.app applies it the 'not written by you' (accept_agent_draft) gate does not apply; ApplySpaces itself stays Orch.app-only. Proposed: keep ByOperator for Orch.app only, or show 'unlock' as the draft's origin. (2) RetagSource with confirm is open to an unlock (D-78 allows retag), so an unlocked terminal can move a source out of an isolated space into a public one, a lasting confidentiality change. Proposed: confirm whether retags out of an isolated space should also stay Orch.app-only.
